about.title: About the Gym Challenge set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Gym Challenge is a Original expansion released on 16 October 2000. It has 132 cards: 132 in the main set and 0 secret rares. There are also 132 1st Edition cards.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 132 main set cards) or the Master set (264 cards, adding the 1st Edition cards).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
